title: Banned role identified by role_name "banned" (English) — switch to index-only once the WG agrees
description: Sweep 2026-11-14 (Mark: don't force English into the UX). crates/mimi-room-policy/src/role.rs:17 BANNED_ROLE_NAME = "banned" and :69 is_banned_role() require role_index 1 AND role_name exactly "banned" (case-sensitive; tests/roles.rs:486). Consumers: authorize.rs has_banned_role (canBan/canUnban), role.rs validate (fixed-membership exemption), mimid-server hub/policy.rs is_banned_in and its callers (rejoin, external commits, proposals). This follows room-policy-04 §8.1.3 as written. Proposed to the WG (held, IETF notes/2026-11-14-mimi-issues-from-table-draft.md item 3, comment on mimi-room-policy #33): identify the banned role by index alone; role_name is display text that MAY be localized. Do: when the WG agrees (or Mark decides to deviate earlier), make is_banned_role index-only, update tests, and drop the forced "banned" name from tools/interop/chat default_roles. Don't change before then without Mark's decision.
close_reason: Mark decided 2026-11-14 to deviate ahead of the WG: banned role is role_index 1 whatever its name (commit 5a3aa0a)
